CursorHookFunction

Signature

CursorHookFunction(STRUCT WMWinHookStruct &s)

Handle cursor hook events.

Window hook function. The XPS profile is plotted from E to F. Activate window, e.g after pressing “Restore Settings”.

Parameters

  • s (STRUCT WMWinHookStruct): Igor action structure describing the control or window event.

Returns

  • Variable: Igor callback status; nonzero indicates that the event was handled.

GraphHookFunction

Signature

GraphHookFunction(STRUCT WMWinHookStruct &s)

Handle panel hook events.

Window is about to be killed. When using case 2 then I cannot KillWindow and KillDataFolder. See the discussion with Wavemetrics. If you want to use case 2, then you need to invoke. Execute/P cmdStr. I do not see any issue in using here case 17 (14.12.2023).

Parameters

  • s (STRUCT WMWinHookStruct): Igor action structure describing the control or window event.

Returns

  • Variable: Igor callback status; nonzero indicates that the event was handled.
